description: Becton, Dickinson and Company, incorporated under the laws of the State of New Jersey in November 1906 as successor to a New York business started in 1897 and with executive offices in Franklin Lakes, New Jersey, is a global medical technology company engaged in the development, manufacture and sale of a broad range of medical supplies, devices, laboratory equipment and diagnostic products used by healthcare institutions, physicians, life science researchers, clinical laboratories, the pharmaceutical industry and the general public. It provides customer solutions focused on improving medication management and patient safety, supporting infection prevention practices, equipping surgical and interventional procedures, improving drug delivery, aiding anesthesiology care and enhancing diagnostics, and its BD Life Sciences segment provides products for the safe collection and transport of diagnostic specimens and instruments and reagent systems to detect a broad range of infectious diseases, healthcare-associated infections and cancers.
